units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 1:1">Naz. I, 1</cite> <he>אהא נ׳</he> Y. ed. (Mish. ed. <cite ref="N00317"><he>נָוֶה</he></cite>; Bab. ed. <cite ref="N00010"><he>נָאֶה</he></cite>) I will be good-looking (let my hair grow, a substitute for <cite ref="N00447"><he>נָזִיר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00566"><he>כִּינּוּי</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:5:2">Cant. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>ונ׳ במעשה אבותי</he> and I am beautiful (worthy) through the deeds of my fathers; <he>ונ׳ בפני קוני</he> beautiful in the sight of my Master; <he>ונ׳ אני במדבר</he> and I proved worthy in the desert; a. fr.
